Name: cantibleChaos's BFAV Fancy Chickens for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from cantibleChaos, I have converted their BFAV Fancy Chickens (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13237) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to cantibleChaos for the original mod 

Fancy Chickens live in coops and some breeds produce differently colored chicken eggs that can be used to make mayo like the vanilla chicken eggs.

Enjoy!
